<template>
	<AsamTooltip
		:append-to="targetElement"
		trigger="click"
		content="挂载到 .target 容器"
		placement="top"
	>
		<AsamButton type="default" class="target">点击打开提示</AsamButton>
	</AsamTooltip>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
const targetElement = ref('');
onMounted(() => {
	targetElement.value = '.target';
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.target {
	position: relative;
	margin-top: 20px;
}
</style>
